warnings.resp-478: Breathe without forcing. Shorten the counts or stop if you feel dizzy, short of breath, or uncomfortable.
warnings.ice-dive: Do not immerse your face or hold your breath. Avoid this practice if you have heart or circulation problems, feel faint, cannot tolerate cold, or have been advised against it by a healthcare professional.
warnings.wall-push: Stop if you feel pain, dizziness, or difficulty breathing. Adjust the effort to your physical abilities.
warnings.butterfly-hug: Slow down or stop if tapping increases distress, dissociation, or difficult memories.
warnings.shaking: Stop if you feel overwhelmed, dissociated, dizzy, or in pain. This practice does not replace professional trauma support.
warnings.physio-sigh: Practise seated and without forcing. Stop if you feel dizzy, in pain, or short of breath.
warnings.voo-sound: Keep the sound comfortable. Stop if you feel dizzy, in pain, or experience breathing or voice discomfort.
warnings.psoas-release: Change position or stop if you feel pain, numbness, or discomfort. Seek professional advice for persistent pain.
warnings.visual-countdown: If closing your eyes increases discomfort or difficult images, keep them open and choose a neutral visual reference.
warnings.self-hug: Release the pressure or stop if contact feels uncomfortable, painful, or distressing.
warnings.pmr-jacobson: Do not tense an injured or painful area. Stop if the practice increases pain or causes cramps.
